_comment: The ART palette — what kindling/tools/cut.mjs's `fit --palette` snaps a generated sprite to. Deliberately NOT turf/js/palette.js: that PAL object is the whole UI+terrain+HUD palette (30+ colours, most of them floor tiles and HP-bar greys that a character sprite has no business touching). Thirty-two colours a Metal-Slug-Tactics-register sprite draws with. Doubled from the original sixteen (2026-08-28) after the first-draft casting sheet: a believable street cast needs hair colour, a second skin ramp, and denim/sneaker/jewelry accents that aren't part of either faction's colour-block — a flat streetwear+faction-trim palette alone couldn't cover what actually showed up. Magenta is never listed here: by the time `fit` runs, `key` has already turned it into alpha, so it is not a colour the sprite's opaque pixels should ever land on. Existing keys from the sixteen-colour version keep their old values unchanged; everything below the halfway mark is new.
